transcript: Bhai aaj tumhe dikhata hu power of prompt. Par sabse pehle Pinterest pe chal jao, jo bhi ek reference image achhi lag rahi ho usko download karke ChatGPT pe attach karo aur yeh pehla wala prompt daal do. Tumhe JSON format mil jayega. Bhai apna image attach karke yeh second wala prompt daalo aur image ka output itna zyada badhiya lag raha hai. Ab share kar do isko zyada se zyada apne doston ke sath aur comment kar dena prompt dono prompts ke liye. Milta hu tumse next video mein, tab tak ke liye Jai Mata Di.
